channel.title: FFIP LinkedIn rotation
channel.description: Fly Fishing Insider Podcast articles queued for LinkedIn

item.title: Fly Tying Materials List - 25 Winter Tools and Materials
item.description: A fly tying materials list for winter: the vise, tools, hooks, beads, dubbing, hackle and UV resin to stock now, plus the flies to tie for a winter trout box.

item.title: Peacock Bass and Tigerfish on the Fly: Jungle Tips from Jeff Currier | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Jeff Currier's practical advice for peacock bass and tigerfish: popper-and-streamer teamwork, bright flies, strong leaders and choosing a hosted trip.

item.title: Passing of the Torch: Episode 123 | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Episode 123 explained: founder Greg Keenan hands the Fly Fishing Insider Podcast to Christian Bacasa, with lessons on community, shops and chironomid setups.

item.title: Why Fly Boxes Rust Your Flies and How to Fix It | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Why waterproof fly boxes rust hooks, how silicone slots hold flies, and what the Tacky founders learned designing a box that lets flies dry out.

item.title: The Chamois Trick for Anglers After a Long Day | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: A simple chamois towel and a quick river rinse can make the drive home after a long day on the boat far more comfortable. Here is how I do it.

item.title: Fly Fishing Gifts Under $200: 12 Upgrades Anglers Love
item.description: These 12 fly fishing gifts under $200 run from a Rising net and full rod kit to waders, boots and merino, so you can give a real upgrade without guessing.

item.title: Belize vs Mexico Flats Fishing - Which to Book First
item.description: Belize or Mexico for your first saltwater fly fishing trip: a clear pick, compared on species, DIY options and getting there, plus a hybrid Belize trip report.

item.title: Become an Alaska Fly Fishing Guide: Bradley Bonnett | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Bradley Bonnett shares what it really takes to guide in Bristol Bay, Alaska: licensing, packing, fly tying, mental toughness and the work behind the fishing.

item.title: Winter Fly Fishing Mistakes: 9 Errors and How to Fix Them
item.description: These winter fly fishing mistakes cost you trout and can put you at risk. Get the fix for each one, from drift speed and fly size to ice shelves and cold water.

item.title: How the Fly Fishing Collaborative Builds Aquaponics Farms | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Bucky Buckstaber explains how the Fly Fishing Collaborative uses aquaponics farms to help orphanages and communities grow food, and how anglers can get involved.

item.title: Better Strip Sets: 5 Fixes for Missed Streamer Strikes | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Missing streamer strikes? Five practical fixes for a better strip set: rod tip low, constant contact, extended arms, the tarpon retrieve, and sharp hooks.

item.title: Fly Fishing the Black Hills of South Dakota: Wild Trout and Big Hoppers | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Spearfish Creek and the Black Hills offer unstocked wild trout and giant grasshopper fishing. Here is how to approach the region, from our guest Pete of Finn Provisions.

item.title: Tenkara Myths Busted: Fixed-Line Fly Fishing | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: A longtime tenkara angler explains the myths, the gear (rod, line, hackled flies) and why a beginner mindset makes you better at all fly fishing.

item.title: Fly Subscription Boxes: Peter Long of Freestone | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Peter Long of Freestone Fly Fishing explains how monthly fly memberships help beginners, how the boxes grew, and what a tying starter kit includes.

item.title: Ascension Bay Fly Fishing - Permit, Bones and Tarpon
item.description: What fly fishing in Ascension Bay, Mexico is really like: permit-first guided skiff fishing, big bonefish schools and the late May to mid-July tarpon run.

item.title: Best Permit Fishing in the World - 5 Proven Fisheries
item.description: Best permit fishing in the world, by species: Atlantic permit in Ascension Bay and Belize, Africanus permit only in Oman, Indo-Pacific on the Seychelles atolls.

item.title: River Observation Routine for Fly Fishing | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Observation starts at home and never stops. A step-by-step routine for reading the weather, bugs, and water before you make your first cast.

item.title: Euro Nymphing Tips from Lance Egan | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Competition angler Lance Egan on the rod, line, leader, and casting habits that make Euro nymphing work, and how to graduate to thinner leaders.

item.title: Wading Safety: Aluminum Boot Treads for Slick Rivers | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Slick rocks and slate bottoms cause falls. Learn how aluminum boot treads work, what installation mistakes to avoid, and tips for safer wading.

item.title: Sea-Run Cutthroat on the Fly: Timing, Flies and Setup | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Sea-run cutthroat are a forgotten Pacific Northwest fishery. Learn when they run, which flies to tie, and the rod, line and leader setup that lands them.

item.title: Fly Fishing Trip Gift Ideas - 10 Bucket-List Trips for 2027
item.description: A fly fishing trip gift for 2027: 10 bucket-list trips from Alaska to Argentina, verified starting prices, best seasons, and how gifting works with Frontiers.

item.title: Inside Angling Trade Magazine with Tim Romano | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Angling Trade's Tim Romano on trade publishing, honest gear reviews, fly shops versus online sales, and how photography opened the door to the industry.

item.title: Islander Reels: Built to Last a Lifetime | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Islander Reels' brand manager on British Columbia machining, mirror-polished fly reels, and why one company builds fly, centerpin and mooching reels.

item.title: Whiskey Leather Works: A Montana Maker Story | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: How a Missoula couple turned leather belts and hand-forged buckles into a respected fly fishing brand, and what small makers can learn from their story.

item.title: Stillwater Tactics with Phil Rowley | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Stillwater lessons from Episode 110 with Phil Rowley: why depth and retrieve speed matter, how the countdown method works, and when to fish attractors.

item.title: Fly Fishing Australia with Josh Hutchins | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Guide Josh Hutchins on fly fishing Australia: Murray cod on topwater, barramundi gear, leader tips for toothy fish and the blue bastard.

item.title: What to Buy a Fly Fisherman - 14 Gifts for Non-Anglers
item.description: Not sure what to buy a fly fisherman? These 14 no-size, no-rod-matching gifts are sorted by budget, so a non-angler can shop with total confidence.

item.title: Practice Before You Fish: Casting Lessons from Heather Hodson | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Heather Hodson on learning to cast the right way, why the roll cast comes first, and why practice before a trip beats hoping on the water.

item.title: Why Your Permit Leader and Fly Line Must Work Together: Bruce Chard's System | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Bruce Chard explains why long leaders and heavy crabs demand a matched fly line, and how to stop hinging and slack from ruining permit presentations.

item.title: Sight Fishing Cruising Trout in Stillwater
item.description: How to sight fish cruising trout on a lake: spotting fish in clear water, leading a moving target, and the presentations that draw a confident eat.
